overview.title: A fortress on the waves
overview.p1: The Sea Castle, or Qasr al-Bahr, is a Portuguese fortress built in the 16th century to control Safi's port. Its walls rise directly above the Atlantic.
overview.p2: It is one of the city's most photographed landmarks. Evening light enhances the stone and ocean.
overview.p3: Combine it with a medina walk and the fishing port for a full morning or afternoon.
